objective: share a first report within 9 days of signup (the data-derived activation window)

trigger.source_object: track_events (Customer.io custom event signed_up, forwarded from the CDP)
trigger.re_entry: off: one activation journey per person

entry_filters.condition: customer.created_at within the last 1 day (excludes backfilled signups)

suppressions: invited by a teammate whose workspace is already activated (they get the invitee path)

holdout.assignment: warehouse: lmm_holdout_activation = (abs(hash(workspace_id)) % 10 = 0), synced as a customer attribute before entry
holdout.sizing: 3,000 signups a month, 28% baseline activation within 9 days, 5-point lift. Randomized by workspace, so signups in one workspace are not independent: design effect 1.15 (ESTIMATE: 1.3 entrants per workspace and ICC 0.5, both unmeasured until workspace_id is confirmed; re-size when they are). 862 holdout signups, 2.9 months of entries plus the 9-day window: read at about 3.2 months (engine/measurement/stats.py feasible --outcome-window-days 9 --design-effect 1.15)

frequency.cap: at most 1 lifecycle email per day and 3 per week across all flows; at most 1 in-app modal per session
frequency.quiet_hours: email and push 08:00 to 20:00 recipient local; no SMS in this flow

steps.message: Welcome: connect your first data source
Modal: connect a source in two clicks
Reminder: the one step before your first report
Invite the person who asks you for the numbers
Modal: start from the weekly summary template
Plain text from a named onboarding lead: reply and I will set it up with you

exit.then: enter the post-activation flow (first week of value)

measurement.primary_metric: activated within 9 days of signup (Mixpanel funnel signed_up then activation_reached, 9-day conversion window, broken down by lmm_holdout_activation)
measurement.read_after: 862 holdout signups past their 9-day window (about 3.2 months at current volume; re-size once workspace size is measured); no read before
guardrails: support tickets per signup not rising

data_dependencies.name: activation_reached
data_dependencies.note: fires for 28% of mature signups within 9 days; 31% ever

data_dependencies.name: workspace_id
data_dependencies.note: needed for account-level holdout assignment; confirm it is on the customer profile

data_dependencies.name: first_data_source
data_dependencies.note: used in the invite email with a fallback; set server-side when connected_data_source fires

data_dependencies.name: data_sync_completed
data_dependencies.note: not in the tracking plan; the data_ready_push step stays off until engineering emits it server-side when the first sync finishes
